Set up a new Rust CLI project at `nohook/` via `cargo init`, with dependencies:

- `reqwest 0.13.4` (json feature) — HTTP client
- `tokio 1.53.1` (full) — async runtime, required by reqwest's async API
- `serde` + `serde_json` — for typed JSON (de)serialization of API responses

`src/main.rs` has a working example that GETs `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1` and deserializes it into a `Post` struct. `cargo build` completes cleanly (one harmless unused-field warning from the demo struct). Ready to replace the demo endpoint/struct with your actual API.
